style_summary: A high-impact, digital-native promotional poster utilizing a strict bento-box grid. The visual vocabulary is entirely constrained to a stark two-color duotone palette. It merges a complex typographic system (ranging from massive brutalist sans-serifs to elegant handwritten scripts and tall condensed fonts) with wireframe tech icons. The integrated photography acts as contextual canvases, also heavily treated with a monochrome duotone filter. The aesthetic is tech-forward, utilitarian, and hacker-chic.

environment_variables.PHOTO_WALL_TEXT: IDEAS > PROMPTS > IMPACT (Environmental text inside the top-right photo)
environment_variables.PRIMARY_FEATURE_TEXT: 365 DAYS PROGRAM • UNLIMITED ACCESS (Heavy sans-serif inside solid pill)
environment_variables.SECONDARY_PROMO_TEXT: 7 days of 0-credit Fast Gens (Tall condensed text inside outlined card)
environment_variables.CERTIFICATE_DETAILS: CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION... 'Creative Thinker' (in script)... DATE MAY 29, 2025

zones.typography_zone: Multiple blocks scaling from massive 100pt hero text down to 10pt certificate micro-copy
zones.focal_zone: The human interaction photos (working at laptop, holding paper) placed in the right column
zones.negative_space: Zero internal negative space; it is entirely replaced by uniform thick black gutters separating the modules

composition.depth_logic: Flat UI for the grid. Environmental depth exists ONLY inside the photographic inserts, flattened by the harsh duotone color mapping.
composition.scale_contrast: Extreme contrast between the container-filling 'GPT IMAGE 2' and the delicate handwritten signature on the certificate.
composition.edge_treatment: Every modular card has uniform rounded border-radii. Photography must crop perfectly to these rounded corners.

typography.font_pairing_strategy: Industrial brutalist meets functional tech and personal handwriting.

hierarchy.style: Ultra-black weight sans-serif (e.g., Impact or Helvetica Black), tightly kerned
hierarchy.position: Filling the largest left bento block
Inside the certificate photo ('Creative Thinker', Signature)

text_constraints: Ensure strong visual separation between the heavy geometric fonts and the delicate script fonts
Text must respect the boundaries of its respective bento card

color_constraints.special_rules: All photorealistic elements (faces, hands, laptops, paper, background walls) MUST be mapped to the black/lime-yellow duotone gradient.
forbidden: any third color or realistic skin tones

bento_cards.physical: Rounded rectangles. Mix of solid yellow fills and black fills with thin yellow strokes
bento_cards.placement: Tightly packed into a masonry layout

wireframe_icons.physical: Thin 1pt line-art vector icons (wireframe globe, right-pointing arrow)
wireframe_icons.placement: Anchoring text inside the smaller UI cards

do: Apply the duotone filter globally over both vector UI and photographic layers
Use mixed typography (Heavy + Condensed + Script) to create reading rhythm
avoid: using the same font weight for every single text block
